groups.keeperCase: projects update metadata with detail access=%s

cases.deletedCase: omits the schedule and projects legacy availability without update detail access
cases.invariant: Public snapshot excludes privileged update metadata.
cases.transferredAssertions: Exact public version/channel object; absent schedule; schedule getter not called; sole session ownership; resolved config hash.

cases.deletedCase: includes the full update availability and schedule with update detail access
cases.invariant: Privileged snapshot retains full update objects.
cases.transferredAssertions: Availability and schedule retain reference identity, including commit details.

groups.keeperCase: coalesces refresh waiters by strength and recovers after probe %s

cases.deletedCase: does not let a post-connect passive refresh absorb an explicit probe
cases.invariant: Probe and passive strength lanes collect separately and publish in settlement order.
cases.transferredAssertions: Two exact public collector calls; probe cache/version/broadcast then passive cache/version/broadcast.

cases.deletedCase: retains a displaced passive refresh after a faster probe settles
cases.invariant: Failed probe cannot discard in-flight passive work.
cases.transferredAssertions: Probe rejects; joining passive waiter starts no third collection; both passive waiters resolve to the original summary.

cases.deletedCase: recovers each strength lane after rejection without discarding an older success
cases.invariant: A failed probe releases only its lane and allows later probe recovery.
cases.transferredAssertions: Passive result survives; a fresh probe invokes collection a third time and replaces the cache.

cases.deletedCase: rejects an invalid explicit delivery account before the agent runner
cases.invariant: Admission validates explicit account before scheduling execution.
cases.transferredAssertions: First validation rejects with exact HTTP 400 error and runId; runner never called.

cases.deletedCase: binds omitted delivery accounts to the channel default
cases.invariant: Omitted account resolves to the configured channel default.
cases.transferredAssertions: Successful admission; runner trigger=event and job.delivery.accountId=default.

cases.deletedCase: revalidates an explicit delivery account against queued-run config
cases.invariant: Queued execution revalidates the accepted account.
cases.transferredAssertions: First validation succeeds; second rejects with exact HTTP 400 error and runId; runner never called.

cases.deletedCase: serializes canonical aliases for the same session in dispatch order
cases.invariant: Canonical aliases share one queue while retaining original expressions.
cases.transferredAssertions: Only first runner starts before gate; ordered first/second messages and original session keys; root work drains.

cases.deletedCase: uses fresh config when a queued hook starts after reload
cases.invariant: Queue identity remains accepted while execution reads fresh config.
cases.transferredAssertions: Second run remains queued before gate; receives reloaded config, main agent and original main session; root work drains.

cases.deletedCase: continues a same-session hook queue after a failed run
cases.invariant: Failed predecessor reports failure and releases its queue.
cases.transferredAssertions: Exact Hook First error event to agent:main:main; second shared-session runner starts; root work drains.

groups.keeperCase: settles an explicit waiter when $outcome without private run data

cases.deletedCase: returns the $deliverySuppressionReason terminal suppression reason to an explicit waiter
cases.invariant: Suppressed execution settles its waiter with the public terminal result.
cases.transferredAssertions: HTTP 200 and exact ok/runId/completion including empty disposition, attempted delivery, and empty suppression reason.

cases.deletedCase: returns categorical delivery failure without private run data
cases.invariant: Delivery error is categorical and cannot leak raw diagnostics.
cases.transferredAssertions: HTTP 200; exact completion delivery-failed; excludes credentials, private output/summary/session identifiers and long raw error.

cases.deletedCase: settles an admitted waiter when the isolated runner throws
cases.invariant: Post-admission exception settles the waiter safely.
cases.transferredAssertions: Execution-start callback precedes throw; HTTP 200 and exact error/empty completion; private exception omitted.
